title: Largest Substring Between Two Equal Characters
summary: For a given string, find the length of the longest substring that lies between two identical characters, not counting those characters.
statement: For a given string, find the length of the longest substring that lies between two identical characters, not counting those characters. If no such substring exists, return -1. A substring is a consecutive segment of characters within the string.
constraints: Return the largest number of characters strictly between equal endpoints, or -1 if no character repeats.
hints: For a fixed ending character, its earliest matching start gives the longest span.
Store only the first index of each character and maximize current minus first minus one.
On first sight record the index; on repeats update the answer without overwriting.
Every equal-endpoint candidate is measured against the earliest possible left endpoint, which dominates all later ones.
editorial: Every equal-endpoint candidate is measured against the earliest possible left endpoint, which dominates all later ones.
